## 1. The four-tier cost model (plan §10.1)

| Tier | Definition | Services | Monthly cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 — zero-cost initial build | Track A work, current product, no accounts | Workers Free (Cloudflare is the hosting target); no AI; no DB | **$0** |
| T2 — zero-cost private beta | Track B through B4: sync, accounts, cohort | Workers Free + Supabase Free + username/password-only accounts (self-contained — no external identity or mail service) + in-memory rate limiting + manual pg_dump + provider subdomains | **$0** |
| T3 — future commercial operation | What turning it on actually costs | Workers Paid, Supabase Pro, domain, privacy/ToS, support, license re-clearance | Per provider terms; NOT a launch path |
| T4 — optional paid upgrades on demand | Discrete triggers, each with an observable metric | See the trigger table (§3 below) | Per trigger |

## 3. T4 — optional paid-upgrade triggers (plan §10.6)

| Trigger (observable metric) | Upgrade |
|---|---|
| Sync DB > ~350 MB sustained / pause pain / backup-for-trust | Supabase Pro (from $25/mo) |
| Dynamic requests > ~70K/day sustained or CPU-limit errors (1102) on p99 | Workers Paid ($5/mo) |
| Brand-domain need | Domain (~$10/yr) |
| >50 concurrent-realtime users | Realtime review |
| Commercial decision (D-16 flip) | Full T3 stack + license re-clearance |

## 4. T1/T2 zero-cost posture assertion

The generator asserts: **no paid service appears in the T1/T2 stage
definitions**; every deferred-for-cost feature is listed with its
trigger in §3 above. Generative AI is removed from the product
(2026-11-27 owner decision — see docs/AI_POSTURE.md), so no AI
provider or key can appear in any tier. Accounts are username +
password only: no SMTP, no email delivery, no identity provider,
no OAuth client — by design.
